statement.p: In a recent small survey of airline passengers, 27 said they had flown American in the last year, 22 had flown Jet Blue, and 30 had flown Continental. Of those, 13 reported they had flown on American and Jet Blue, 12 had flown on Jet Blue and Continental, and 11 had flown on American and Continental. 4 passengers had flown on all three airlines.
How many passengers were surveyed? (Assume the results above make up the entire survey.)

solution.p: 47 passengers. We are asking for the size of the union of three non-disjoint sets. Using PIE, we have 27+22+30-(13 +11 + 12) + 4 = {47}\text{.}
